text.ms:
1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan Pendidikan

(Penggal Institusi Pendidikan Kalendar Akademik 2023/2024) 2022.

Pemakaian

2. Peraturan-Peraturan ini hendaklah terpakai bagi kehadiran di institusi

pendidikan kecuali di sekolah ekspatriat dan sekolah antarabangsa bagi kalendar

akademik 2023/2024.

Tempoh penggal institusi pendidikan

3. Tempoh penggal institusi pendidikan bagi kalendar akademik 2023/2024 adalah

sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

Kumpulan A Penggal Pertama

Semua institusi pendidikan di Johor,

Kedah, Kelantan dan Terengganu

19 Mac 2023 hingga 20 April 2023

30 April 2023 hingga 25 Mei 2023

Penggal Kedua

4 Jun 2023 hingga 24 Ogos 2023

Penggal Ketiga

3 September 2023 hingga 14 Disember 2023

2 Januari 2024 hingga 8 Februari 2024

di Melaka, Negeri Sembilan, Pahang,

Perak, Perlis, Pulau Pinang, Sabah,

Sarawak, Selangor, Wilayah

 5 Jun 2023 hingga 25 Ogos 2023

FADHLINA BINTI SIDEK

Menteri Pendidikan

EDUCATION ACT 1996

EDUCATION (TERMS OF EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS

ACADEMIC CALENDAR 2023/2024) REGULATIONS 2022

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 130(2)(b) of the

Education Act 1996 [Act 550], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Education (Terms of Educational

Institutions Academic Calendar 2023/2024) Regulations 2022.

Application

2. These Regulations shall apply to attendance at educational institutions except

at expatriate schools and international schools for the academic calendar 2023/2024.

Duration of terms of educational institutions

3. The duration of terms of educational institutions for the academic

calendar 2023/2024 shall be as specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Group A First Term

All educational institutions in Johore,

Kedah, Kelantan and Terengganu

19 March 2023 to 20 April 2023

30 April 2023 to 25 May 2023

Second Term

4 June 2023 to 24 August 2023

Third Term

3 September 2023 to 14 December 2023

2 January 2024 to 8 February 2024

Group B First Term

All educational institutions in

Malacca, Negeri Sembilan, Pahang,

Perak, Perlis, Penang, Sabah,

Sarawak, Selangor, Federal Territory

of Kuala Lumpur, Federal Territory

of Labuan and Federal Territory of

Putrajaya

20 March 2023 to 21 April 2023

1 May 2023 to 26 May 2023

Second Term

5 June 2023 to 25 August 2023

Third Term

4 September 2023 to 15 December 2023

2 January 2024 to 9 February 2024

Made 9 December 2022

[KPM.PUU.S.100-1/19/8(42); PN(PU2)569/XIV]

FADHLINA BINTI SIDEK

Minister of Education
